body: Opaque base, optional gentle0.96+0.04*sin(pi*t) horizontal multiplier. Never multiply glass transmission over body again. No white shine stripe.

surface_geometry.plane: All surface centers from NEW volume solver. Fullcenter86, not110. Oldv1 liquid heights invalid. Full top cap projects to about69, below neck; no liquid raised to mouth.
surface_geometry.top_color: Use explicit top_srgb table once, with same color id. No additional whitening on top of those values. One visible free top only; no white outline.
surface_geometry.internal_color: Same two adjacent body colors separated by shared front arc d=depth*sqrt(1-u²); no added highlight ellipse/rim.
surface_geometry.tilt: Screen/world gravity defines every plane, not bottle axis. Compute visible chord using same transformed cavity and h. rx=half chord; ry=min(17,17*chord/111), depth=min(16,16*chord/111), then uniform root scale. Do not grow cap thickness with long tilted chord. Clip to transformed cavity. Optical projection never enters volume integrator.
surface_geometry.render_bounds: Top cap can project above h by17; do not change full threshold or draw through neck walls. All surfaces and body use same solver basis and antialiasing.

accessibility: Hues distinct in ordinary vision, not guaranteed for every color-vision deficiency/device. Validate actual screens; optional symbols are a separate feature.
geometry_source: BOTTLE_CONTRACT.json from this v2 bundle only. Fullarea32283.14117647059, unitarea8070.785294117648. Original4unit rules unchanged.
